name: E2E quality 246: a label the project never saw
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the values the instructions below name, never mention facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. No trace was ever sent under the label never-<prompt_handle>. In your first message, write exactly (with the real value of prompt_handle): 'how many traces labelled never-<prompt_handle> did I get in the last hour?'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy says there were no matching traces in the last hour.
Langy says the project has never received traces with that label, or that it found none in any window.
Langy does not invent a time for a newest matching trace.
Langy names one likely cause, such as the app not being instrumented to send that label, a wrong project or API key, or export never set up.
Langy never says or implies that it cannot see or access the data.

parameters.name: world
